newsitem.title: USA: Capsure Holdings to pay $10 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Capsure Holdings to pay $10 dividend.

text.p: Capsure Holdings Corp said Wednesday its directors approved payment of a special cash dividend of $10 a share on October 4, record September 25.
The company said the special dividend is a result of a previously announced review of strategic alternatives undertaken by Capsure's directors.
The dividend will be funded from about $62 million of borrowings under a revolving credit agreement and about $94 million from available cash and marketable securities.
Capsure Holdings provides surety and fidelity bonds throughout the United States. Its shares are trading off one to 17-1/2.
